instruction: Like all the songs played so far in my spotify music player queue, including the current one.
notes: Single-app task (spotify) with no answer. The agent must discover the queue (show_song_queue) and the currently playing song (show_current_song); every queue entry up to and including the current song must be liked, nothing else. Because the number of songs played so far is only known at runtime, the model uses placeholder songs song-queue-1, song-queue-2 (entries before the current song) and song-current; they are declared as domain constants so that supervisor-complete-task's precondition can list every goal conjunct literally. At execution time like_song is repeated once per queue entry up to and including the current one (the placeholder count is illustrative). song-upcoming is a problem object without (played-so-far), showing that songs after the current one must not be liked. The spotify username is the supervisor email from supervisor.show_profile, gated by (profile-known); the password comes from show_account_passwords, gated by (passwords-known). like_song requires both lookups ((queue-known) and (current-song-known)) to have been done. complete_task is called without an answer and is forced last by (task-completed).
